upload.title: Yesterday's News Today — August 10, 2026 | Voyager 2 Power Fix, Rewilded Elephants & More
upload.description:
Your 90-second recap of August 10, 2026. NASA engineers buy Voyager 2 another year of science, rewilded zoo elephants show strong coping skills in South Africa, Binghamton University reports early motor gains in a Duchenne muscular dystrophy drug study, the Toronto Zoo welcomes an endangered pygmy hippo calf, and the Smithsonian Institution marks 180 years since its charter.

Sources:
- Good News Network (all five stories): https://www.goodnewsnetwork.org
  - Voyager 2 power engineering (NASA / Jet Propulsion Laboratory)
  - Elephant rewilding study (Elephant Reintegration Trust of South Africa)
  - Vamorolone / Duchenne muscular dystrophy research (Binghamton University)
  - Pygmy hippo birth (Toronto Zoo)
  - Good News in History, August 10 (Smithsonian Institution charter)
